description: Layouts PUT /api/house must reject with 422 (`errors`: each {type, loc} appears in the response's `detail`, where loc is prefixed with "body") or accept (`valid`). `cases` and `valid` are judged against a file on disk without semantic issues. `inherited` cases (D30) are judged against `baseline`, the file on disk (null: no file, created with If-None-Match: *): issues the baseline already has may stay or move, but not grow; `errors` is then the exact set the 422 lists, or empty when the layout is accepted. Semantic types are the house_* problem kinds (data contract §2.1); structural ones are Pydantic error types. The frontend can run the same cases against its own pre-save checks.

cases.description: at most one placement per item
cells lie inside the grid (x < width)
cells lie inside the grid (y < depth)
every cell points to an existing room (e.g. a deleted one)
cell keys are x,y without padding
the occupied rectangle lies inside the grid
rotation 90 swaps w and d before the check
an n edge needs x < width
structural: only the current schemaVersion can be written

valid.description: the base layout of these cases
w edge at x == width is the east boundary
n edge at y == depth is the south boundary
1x2 rotated by 90 is 2x1 and fits at the last row
several items may share a tile

inherited.description: a cell of a deleted room that is already on disk may stay (M5-03)
counted per (floor, room), not per tile: the inherited tile may move
one more tile of the same missing room makes the layout worse; every tile of that subject is listed
a tile of another missing room is new, even if one tile of a missing room goes
only the issues that got worse are reported; the inherited one is not
growing north shifts every coordinate; issues keyed without coordinates stay the same
an item placed twice on disk may stay placed twice (both copies may move)
a third copy of an item placed twice on disk is worse
a duplicate room id on disk may stay (which one is meant is a judgement)
a placement outside the grid on disk may move and stay outside
an opening on an unknown floor on disk may stay
a malformed cell key is never let through, even if the file on disk has it (the server normalises it when reading)
structural errors block whatever the file on disk has
with no house.json (If-None-Match: *) there is no baseline: every semantic issue is new
